MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an organised and motivated Project Administrator / Administrative Officer to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Project Administrator / Administrative Officer, you will provide administrative and project coordination support to project managers, engineers, supervisors, and operational teams. You will be responsible for maintaining project documentation, coordinating communications, monitoring project records, and ensuring administrative processes are completed accurately and efficiently to support the successful delivery of mining, industrial, and engineering projects.
Key Responsibilities
•	Provide administrative support to project managers, engineers, and operational teams.
•	Prepare, update, and maintain project documentation, reports, registers, and correspondence.
•	Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas, record meeting minutes, and follow up on action items.
•	Maintain project schedules, document control systems, and filing systems.
•	Assist with project planning, resource coordination, procurement, and subcontractor documentation.
•	Process purchase orders, invoices, timesheets, and other project-related administrative records.
•	Liaise with clients, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal departments regarding project requirements and documentation.
•	Monitor project documentation to ensure compliance with company procedures and quality standards.
•	Assist with mobilisation, onboarding, travel arrangements, and accommodation bookings for project personnel where required.
•	Prepare progress reports, spreadsheets, and other administrative documents using Microsoft Office applications.
•	Maintain confidentiality and ensure accurate record-keeping at all times.
•	Comply with workplace health and safety policies, company procedures, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience in a Project Administrator, Administrative Officer, or similar administrative support role.
•	Experience supporting engineering, mining, construction, or industrial projects is highly regarded.
•	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•	High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
•	Experience using project management or document control systems will be highly regarded.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $75,000 – $95,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and professional development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

result.description:
Field Service Technician
Premier Tech Systems and Automation Pty Limited
Full-time
130,000 – $140,000 (inclusive of guaranteed allowances) + super

The company

As part of the well-respected and successful international Premier Tech group, and with an
Australian history dating back to the 1950’s, we are a leader within the bulk handling and
packaging equipment industry in Australia.  We are collaborative and innovative, and we love
what we do.

The role

As part of a national team of field service technicians servicing and commissioning a range of
specialised flexible packaging machinery installed around the country and abroad, you will
travel extensively (approx. 75% of the role) throughout metro and regional VIC, as well as
interstate and the occasional international trip. 

Providing expert advice and service for robotic and conventional palletisers, bagging
machines, wrapping and hooding machines and their corresponding control systems, you
should expect to spend most of your time working on customer sites, with the remaining time
spent working between the West Heidelberg office and home.


JOB DESCRIPTION


Fundamental Duties and responsibilities 	

Perform in-house and on-site equipment installations and start-ups  
•	Install equipment at customers’ locations according to safety standards and established corporate procedures 
•	Perform initial start-ups for installed equipment
•	Test and verify installed equipment at customers’ locations
•	Perform tests and verify the proper functioning of equipment
•	Train customers on the proper operation of the equipment
•	Prepare reports on completed installations
•	Do in-house equipment start-ups before it leaves for customers’ locations

Solve various equipment problems for customers
•	Visit customers in order to diagnose equipment problems
•	Find solutions in collaboration with the engineering team
•	Adjust and repair customers’ equipment and ensure it is operated safely and according to the original specifications
•	Prepare reports following service calls
•	Contribute to product development

Do preventive equipment maintenance at various customers’ locations
•	Evaluate the safety, general state and compliance of various equipment
•	Do preventive maintenance and repair on equipment
•	Ensure proper equipment functioning following maintenance visits
•	Plan following maintenance visits as needed
•	Provide on-site and/or remote technical support to clients
•	Prepare reports on the work performed

Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Diagnose problems and identify possible solutions for customers
•	Help customers find safe solutions to problems
•	Promote preventive maintenance and training services to customers

Other generic tasks as required
•	Preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
•	Assisting Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design of mechanical equipment and plant
•	Selecting tools and equipment
•	Assembling and installing new and modified mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools and controls, and hydraulic power systems
•	Estimating material costs and quantities, and machine requirements
•	Performing and directing field and laboratory tests
•	Collecting and analysing data, carrying out complex computations and preparing diagrams
•	Organising and supervising inspection and maintenance of machines and plant
•	Ensuring that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and contract provisions
•	Prepares detailed drawings and plans of mechanical engineering work in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.
 


Advanced Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Assume responsibility for a certain type of service or equipment for customers
•	Do relatively complex installations at customers’ locations
•	Solve complex equipment problems for customers 
•	Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Master preventive maintenance of equipment and suggest improvements to customers during service calls
•	Meet the demand for technical information from potential customers and promote Premier Tech products to customers 


•	Expert Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Be the go-to person for the team as work is carried out
•	Be an instructor and mentor for new team members
•	Collaborate in the equipment design process with the engineering team 
•	Help develop and implement work procedures and methods 
•	Organize installations or repair work to be done
•	Develop and provide specific technical service expertise to the team 
•	Apply different analysis and problem solving skills to diagnose and repair a variety of equipment  
•	Resolve unusual, major and complex problems on customers’ equipment
•	Do major and non-standard equipment installations at customers’ sites




 
COMPETENCIES PROFILE

Qualifications

At least a trade qualification, associate diploma in engineering or suitable equivalent mechanical/electrical/electronic/control automation qualification.

Technical competencies 	

•	In-depth specific knowledge of Premier Tech packaging machinery including Bottom-Up Filling Technology is highly desirable.
•	Interpreting mechanical and general assembly drawings
•	Interpreting hydraulic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting pneumatic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting electrical schematics
•	Interpreting general installation and industrial buildings layouts
•	Industrial PLC, networks and communication protocols
•	installation, commissioning and maintenance of industrial robots, packaging and powder conveying systems.
•	Installation and optimisation of pneumatically operated equipment
•	Installation, commissioning and troubleshooting of field devices and instrumentation
•	Installation and commissioning of industrial machinery safety systems and guarding.
•	Safe troubleshooting of partially energised systems
•	Troubleshooting PLCs programs, mechanical and electrical installations.
•	Systems and equipment start-up
•	Equipment preventative maintenance
•	Service reports generation
•	Training of machine Operators and Maintenance Crews
•	English communication


Culture

As a well-respected and successful business, we have a range of long term, loyal and
committed team members, creating a solid team environment and providing job security. We
work hard but always find time for a laugh. We care about our team and strive to be an
employer of choice!

What’s in it for you?

•	Competitive salary + travel allowance
•	A professional and friendly work environment
•	A hybrid work arrangement with opportunity to work from home or office (as required) when
•	not travelling
•	Fabulous Employee Assistance Program that includes telehealth appointments and
•	extends to immediate family members
•	On-going training and development.

How to apply

Please apply with a current CV and a separate cover letter outlining why you think
you are the right person for this opportunity.

Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted and we thank you in advance for
your time and interest in working with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

IT Senior Platform Engineer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for IT Senior Platform Engineer – Microsoft Environment (Global Operations) based in our NSW Office.

THE ROLE

As an IT platform Engineer, you will provide Level 1 and Level 2 support in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment while also supporting and maintaining the organisation’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) platform.

You will act as a key point of contact for end users, taking ownership of incidents and service requests from initial triage through to resolution. In addition to end-user support, you will play an active role in D365 administration, security configuration, user role management, and ongoing platform Maintenance.

Working within Freshservice (ITSM) and leveraging NinjaOne (RMM), you will support Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft Defender security tooling, and Dynamics 365 environments. You will contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and operational standardisation across our global IT and business systems landscape.

This role is ideal for a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, improving systems, and supporting business-critical platforms in a global support model.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Desk & End User Support
Provide remote support for users across Europe and the Americas.
Act as primary point of contact for incidents and service requests logged in Freshservice.
Deliver troubleshooting and resolution for:
Windows 10/11 environments
Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
Office applications and collaboration tools
VPN and basic network connectivity issues
Dynamics 365 user access and functional issues
Ensure tickets are categorised, prioritised, and resolved within agreed SLAs.

Dynamics 365 Administration & Platform Support
Administer and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments.
Manage D365 security roles, user access, and permission structures.
Configure and maintain:
Security roles and access profiles
Business units and role-based access controls
Environment-level security settings
Support user onboarding/offboarding within D365.
Troubleshoot D365 functional and access-related issues.
Assist with testing, validation, and deployment of D365 updates and changes.
Maintain environment health, performance monitoring, and basic configuration management.
Coordinate with application owners, vendors, and stakeholders for enhancements and issue resolution.
Ensure governance and compliance standards are maintained across D365 environments.

Identity & Access Management
Administer Active Directory and Entra ID (Azure AD).
Manage user lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, access changes).
Configure and support:
Group memberships
Licensing
MFA and Conditional Access
Mailbox management
Align identity controls with D365 security and access models.

Endpoint & RMM Administration
Monitor and manage endpoints using NinjaOne RMM.
Perform patch management, remote remediation, and system monitoring.
Investigate recurring endpoint issues and implement long-term fixes.
Ensure endpoint compliance with security and configuration standards.

Security & Microsoft Defender
Monitor and respond to Microsoft Defender alerts (Endpoint and M365).
Support security best practices including device hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Escalate and coordinate response to suspected security incidents.
Support security posture across D365 through proper role design, least-privilege access, and periodic access reviews.

Problem Management & Continuous Improvement
Perform root cause analysis on recurring incidents (including D365-related issues).
Contribute to process improvement and service optimisation initiatives.
Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, SOPs, and technical documentation.
Identify opportunities for automation within NinjaOne, Microsoft tools, and D365 workflows.
Support governance and platform optimisation initiatives within the D365 ecosystem.

Collaboration & Global Support
Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, and business systems teams.
Provide technical guidance to junior support staff when required.
Support change management, system updates, and release cycles (including D365 updates).
Participate in shift coverage aligned with Europe and Americas time zones.

ABOUT YOU

Experience
3–6+ years’ experience in IT Support / Service Desk / End User Computing roles.
Experience supporting a Microsoft-based enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience supporting or administering Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Exposure to global or multi-site support operations is desirable.
Experience with ITSM platforms (Freshservice preferred).
Experience with RMM tools (NinjaOne preferred).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Strong working knowledge of:
Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)
Microsoft 365 administration
Exchange Online
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Windows OS administration
MFA and Conditional Access configuration
Dynamics 365 security roles and access management
Role-based access control (RBAC) principles
Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN)

Certifications (Desirable)
Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-102, AZ-900 or similar).
Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910 / MB-920 or similar).

Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global support model.
Customer-first attitude with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
High level of accountability and ownership.

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Assertiv is an IT Security company specialising in Identity related solutions, support, training and managed services. We are currently looking for a talented IDAM Security Engineer with a background in designing, developing, implementing and supporting Identity Security solutions.

We are seeking candidates who possess good technical knowledge and experience with Opentext NetIQ Identity Governance, Silverfort Identity Security Platform, Microsoft Entra ID and related technologies and are willing to do the hard yards when it comes to delivering successful outcomes for our customers. In return, we will provide you with training across a variety of products, on-site (or remote) customer experience, and the support of a great team to help you further develop your skills and experience in IT Security.

Role Description

This role will engage in workforce and customer Identity related projects and undertake the following project-based activities:

· Install and configure Workforce and Customer Identity products.

· Install and configure Identity Security products including ISPM and ITDR.

· Develop integrations between Identity systems and business applications, specifically onboarding applications to Identity Governance systems.

· Conduct functional testing and undertake code fixes as required.

· Assist with System, Integration, Performance and User Acceptance Testing.

· Assist with documentation (Solution Design, Test Cases, Deployment Guides, As-built documents).

· Develop drivers and connectors for connected applications.

· Design and implement single sign-on using open standards (OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, WS-FED).

· Design and implement advanced authentication processes (Multi-Factor, Risk Based Auth).

· Assist with handover and/or training to customer BAU/Operations teams.

· Provide ongoing solution support for customer implementations.
